name: local_diff
description: Build a local checkout diff against a freshly fetched remote branch, including staged, unstaged, committed-ahead, and untracked changes. Does not alter files, stage, commit, push, or check out. Input: repoPath, baseRemote?, baseBranch?.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the local git checkout to diff.

baseRemote.description: Configured git remote name to fetch and diff against. Defaults to 'origin'.

baseBranch.description: Remote branch name to fetch and diff against. Defaults to 'main'.

repoPath.description: Resolved absolute path of the diffed checkout.

baseRemote.description: Git remote name used as the diff baseline.

baseBranch.description: Remote branch name used as the diff baseline.

baseCommit.description: SHA of the freshly fetched remote-tracking baseline commit.

headCommit.description: SHA of the checkout's current HEAD.

changedFiles.description: Tracked and untracked file paths that differ from the baseline.

untrackedFiles.description: Untracked file paths present in the working tree.

diff.description: Unified diff text (tracked changes plus appended untracked-file diffs), capped at max_chars.

diffChars.description: Total character length of the untruncated diff.

truncated.description: True when the diff exceeded the cap and was truncated.
